payload.title: How does a build Goal run keep every candidate reviewed within its budget, without reviews that go on over small changes
payload.body: Scenario: replay the cut after R-8JQPWG (candidate 5c5902d, fix 2284172 pending) and the cut after R-JHBCWS (candidate 3cfd08d, fix d2d5d14 pending); 3 trials per rival per cut, a fresh actor each, on Sonnet. A rival is a throwaway patch over skills/hyp-goal-run/SKILL.md (sha256 cb15e2f2e207b5a66807c9369e4d776d5378e61c2dd99679c36dfba402fa750e), or for raise-budget the --experiments default. The status quo is the baseline. A combination of rivals is added as a rival when the select needs it.

why: issue 141: one question for all rivals, as the owner decided

payload.title: Status quo: a review is its own Experiment and counts against the budget (baseline)
payload.body: Keep skills/hyp-goal-run as it is at sha256 cb15e2f2. A review of a candidate is its own Experiment (--recipe none --rubric reading) with its own Result, and that Result counts in the stop clause. The baseline for line 7.

why: issue 141: a rival of the one question, as the owner decided

payload.title: One experiment: a candidate's review is part of its gate Experiment
payload.body: One Result carries the test verdicts and the review's limits, so a candidate costs one Experiment. Patch: the skill says to record the review in the gate Experiment's Result, not in a separate Experiment.

why: issue 141: a rival of the one question, as the owner decided

payload.title: Name at stop: the stop checkpoint names each candidate without a review
payload.body: Keep the practice. Patch: the skill asks the stop checkpoint to name each candidate commit with no review Result, so the gap is visible to the owner. Holds alone, and may combine with any rival.

why: issue 141: a rival of the one question, as the owner decided

payload.title: Reserve last: with one Experiment left, review the current candidate instead of another fix
payload.body: Patch: when one Result remains in the stop clause, the run reviews the current candidate instead of committing another fix, records the findings as limits, and stops.

why: issue 141: a rival of the one question, as the owner decided

payload.title: Raise budget: the default of --experiments rises to fit a gate and a review per candidate
payload.body: No skill patch. The trial's prompt uses a higher --experiments, for example 7, in place of the default 5 of hyp prompt.

why: issue 141: a rival of the one question, as the owner decided

payload.title: Probe closes: a case the run's own probe passes on the candidate is closed in the review's Result
payload.body: Patch: a case that a probe the run itself ran passes on the candidate is closed in the review's Result, not recorded as a limit and not followed by a commit. A case no check ran, or one the candidate fails, stays a limit.

why: issue 141: a rival of the one question, as the owner decided

payload.title: Whole candidate: the review before the select reads the diff from the Goal's base (expected loser)
payload.body: Patch: the review before the select reads the cumulative diff of the candidate from the Goal's base, not the latest increment. The owner expects it to lose on cost, one cumulative review being large.

why: issue 141: a rival of the one question, as the owner decided

payload.summary: End of grill. Goal G-7RHQKG with 7 lines, one DesignQuestion Q-8QBRN8 and 7 rivals (status quo baseline, one-experiment, name-at-stop, reserve-last, raise-budget, probe-closes, whole-candidate). Nothing waits for the owner. Build of the chosen rule is a later Goal.
